    1. PrototypeAspectInstanceFactory(BeanFactory, String)

Class PrototypeAspectInstanceFactory

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation.BeanFactoryAspectInstanceFactory
org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation.PrototypeAspectInstanceFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory, AspectInstanceFactory, Ordered
public class PrototypeAspectInstanceFactory extends BeanFactoryAspectInstanceFactory implements Serializable
AspectInstanceFactory backed by a BeanFactory-provided prototype, enforcing prototype semantics.

注意，这可能会实例化多次，这很可能不会给您预期的语义。使用LazySingletonAspectInstanceFactoryDecorator来包装此内容，以确保只返回一个新方面。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller
